geometry_interpretation: The canopy is three separate OBJ meshes, one closed cuboid per row; each OBJ has 8 vertices and 6 quadrilateral faces. Sionna RadioMaterial uses a plane-slab Fresnel model at an intersected surface, not a calibrated volumetric plant model. The 0.8 m material slab thickness is distinct from the cuboid's 0.6 m plan width and may be an important model mismatch.
interaction_interpretation: PathSolver refraction is enabled in all four core cases. A path classified with refraction at two canopy-row interactions is evidence that the ray solution traverses the closed proxy. The interaction type and object names are read from Paths.interactions and Paths.objects; no path class is inferred from amplitude.
limitations: Material values are controls/placeholders, not plant dielectric measurements.
Sionna's slab material model is not a validated thick vegetation volume model.
Radio-map path gain is clipped at 1e-15 for dB plots and differences.
Aggregate path-coefficient power is the sum of individual |a|^2 values and is not RSS; coherent CIR combination is delay-dependent.
Path length is estimated as c0 times the Sionna absolute path delay.
